create_youtube_transcript_loader: create a YoutubeLoader instance with a YouTube video ID and optional language and proxy settings
parse_youtube_video_id: parse a YouTube URL string and extract the 11-character video ID if valid
load_youtube_transcript: load a YouTube video transcript into a Document object using the YoutubeLoader.load method
aload_youtube_transcript: asynchronously load a YouTube video transcript into a Document generator using YoutubeLoader.aload
test_youtube_loader_languages: test the YoutubeLoader with multiple language fallbacks to find the best available transcript
